The Future of Transportation: Embracing Electric Cars

As the world is trying to be more green, electric cars are getting more populer with people that care about the Earth. Unlike cars that run on gas, electric cars run on elecricity that is stored in batteries that you can charge up, and they don't put out no smog and they help with lessening the need for gas.

One of the main good things about electric cars is how good they are for the environment, by using gas instead of elecricity people can help cut down on green house gasses and air polluation which helps make cities cleaner and the planet healthier. Also a lot of electric cars run on green energy which makes them even better for the Earth.

Another big plus about electric cars is how much it cost to own one, even though the first price of an electric car is more then a regular car, the money you save on gas and fixing the car is a lot. Electricity is cheaper then gas and electric cars have less parts that can go wrong so they cost less to fix.

Electric cars also give you a ride that is smoother and not as loud, with electric cars you get instant power and they don't have as many parts so the ride is more fun and more smooth. Also with the new tech in the batteries the distance you can go on one charge has gone up a lot so going on long trips is not so bad.

Governments all over the world are helping people get electric cars by giving stuff like money back, tax breaks and letting people drive in carpool lanes. These things are helping people switch from cars that run on gas to electric cars faster.

In all electric cars are a big step in making transportation more green and more efficient, as the tech keeps getting better and more charging stations are built the future of driving is getting more green, smart and easy to get to. Whether you want to help the planet, save money or just like the way electric cars drive they are a great pick for people that drive today.

"Electric cars or Electric Vehicles are cars that run on elecricity instead of gas or diesel, they work by having a big battery that holds the elecricity that then goes to an electric motor that turns the wheels, unlike regular cars that burn gas to make power, electric cars don't put out any fumes from the tail pipe, making them cleaner and better for the environment.

One of the best things about electric cars is that they cost less to run, gas is cheaper then gas and electric cars have less parts that can go wrong so they need less maintence, they don't need oil changes, they don't have as many belts and hoses, and they have a system that helps charge the battery while you are driving.

Another good thing is that they are quiet and ride smooth, electric motors make less noise then cars that run on gas, which makes for a more comfy ride, and many electric cars also have a thing called instant torque which makes them go fast when they start to move.

But electric cars do have some problems, the main one is how far they can go on one charge, while older electric cars could only go a short ways, new electric cars can go 200 to 300 miles or more on one charge, and even though there is more charging stations out there, there still isn't as many as gas stations.

To charge an electric car can take from 30 minutes up to a few hours, depending on what kind of charger you use and what kind of battery the car has, most people charge there cars at home with a regular outlet or a wall charger, while public fast chargers can cut down on how long it takes to charge.

As time goes on, electric cars are getting more efficient, more affordable and easier to get, and also goverments all over the world are giving people money back for buying electric cars, which helps people stop using gas and helps with the climate change.

In short, electric cars are a good option instead of regular cars, they help the environment, they cost less to run, and they have a smooth ride, and as the tech keeps getting better, electric cars are going to be a even more common thing for people to drive."

There's more then just the stuff like saving money and not throwing away as much food, veggies that you grow at home are usually better for you, they get picked when they are the best, and that keeps the taste and the good stuff in them that gets lost when they have to travel a long way and be kept for a long time, Also when you grow your own veggies you don't have to worry about bad stuff like pesticides and preservatives in your food, and that makes you feel good about what you eat.

But the best part is the stuff you go through when you garden, gardening helps you be more patient and helps you pay attention to what's going on and makes you really like the way nature works, It teaches you that food is not just something you put in your mouth, it's something you have to work with, take care of and see grow, Whether it's a tomato that gets a lot of sun or a lettuce that is really crisp, every time you get a harvest it's a little win in a bigger thing called being able to take care of yourself.

Some people might say that gardening is not something that people who are really busy or don't have a lot of room can do, and that is true, but even a small pot or a box that is on a window can give you some fresh veggies, The important thing is not how big the space you have is, its more about wanting to grow, wanting to learn and wanting to take care of things.

In a time when the weather is not sure and there is not enough food for everyone, growing your own veggies is more then just doing something you like to do, it's a way of saying that you take care of things, it's like a little fight back against using up to much stuff and it's a way to get back in touch with the ground, So if you have a yard or just a spot on your balcony, start with something small, plant a seed, watch it grow, taste the difference, the ground will be happy and so will your body.

Getting enough sleep was one of the most important things that I didn't think about till now, For a long time I thought that if I work more hours and stay up late to get my work done I would be successful, But after a while I started to see some things happen like me getting really mad, Not being able to focus and feeling like my brain was tired all the time, It wasn't till I started to make sleep a priority by going to bed by 10 and waking up when my body wanted to that I started to feel like I was getting enough rest, I figured out that sleep is not just about getting my body to rest it's also important for my memory, my feelings and even my creativity, I used to think that I was tough for not getting enough sleep but now I see that those times when I didn't get enough sleep made me not so strong and not able to think straight, Making a schedule for when I go to sleep and sticking to it has made a big difference, I wake up feeling more awake, I don't get as mad as I used to and I can think about things better, Even little things like not using my phone an hour before I go to sleep and doing things that help me get ready for sleep has helped, I found out that taking care of myself is not being mean to myself it's something that is important, Sleep is not something that I can just do without, it's something that I need, Now I go through my day with more patience and I am more in the moment knowing that resting is not like taking a break from life it's something that is important for living a good life, This change has made me feel more calm and able to take things that come my way.

Homework for little kids isn't about getting good grades or learning stuff by heart it's about making good habits and helping them be on their own and also making them like learning, I have found out that the good part is in doing the work not in the end result, things like drawing a picture of a animal that you like or reading a short story together helps kids get better at paying attention and be creative and feel good about them self, these things don't just keep kids busy they also make them feel like they did a good job and show them that learning can be cool and important, I have learned to be slow and not rush them and to like to ask questions and to be happy with what they do even if it's not perfect, Homework when you are little is more about being together and helping them like what they like and helping them see the world and showing them that asking questions is a good thing, It's also a time for parents and kids to be together and talk about how they feel and build trust, I have found that when you do homework with a nice way and in a fun way it becomes part of the day and not something that you don't like, In the end the reason we do homework for little kids is not so they will do well on a test but so they will be kids that know what they are doing and like to learn and feel like their parents like them and think they are good, In that way homework for little kids is more than just something you have to do it's a small step to learning all your life.
